dog.description_text:
Willow is a loving, smart dog who is looking for a fresh start after losing the home she once knew. She is a great listener, enjoys being around people, and has a gentle, affectionate nature. We have been especially impressed by how sweet and patient she is with children, always taking a calm and gentle approach.

While Willow is doing her best, shelter life is not where she belongs. She is ready to leave it behind and find a family of her own where she can settle in, be loved, and enjoy the happy life she deserves.

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, you must click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
